result:
In order to truly want something, it must have a place in your heart. In all of my work at supporting those who want something, I have found that the greatest motivation comes from the heart. People naturally want things they are passionate about, and this has come naturally with time for many people.

There have been experiments that state that when something is posted on multiple screens or written on multiple surfaces while a person is engaged in the task at hand, it increase the attention and focus of the task being performed. In essence, when you write about something you genuinely want, it speaks to your heart and likely brings more focus and attention. 

When you take time to do something that you genuinely want, you are more likely to want to have accomplished something. A key thingequal about people is the fact that they can be motivated quite quickly.

I have worked with people who are athletes who were once named number one in their league but have since fallen out of their position as they wanted something more. This is the thing though: they were not motivated by the million dollar contract or high position that they wanted. They wanted the place where they asserted their own values unconditionally and thus caused themselves more motivation.

In this way there are so many great opportunities and a lot of doors that are opened, when you want something. Even you can manage to do something that is totally not in your field, the only thing needed is that you want the place. Everyone have the time in their life for something they want.

I believe that focusing on positive words like hungry and things could allow us to stay hungry, like something in our pathway is a reward. When you set conditions like this, you are more likely the have the courage and discipline to achieve the things you want simply for the love of the act due to the unconditional reward for completing the very sentence you are trying.

I understand an individual's attraction or magnet setting out each day into a future that has the potential to hold a suprising and unknown outcome. The greatest reward of making this journey into a fulfilling one is the act of celebrating your own ability to claim the moments when you are willing to make that step forward together without hesitation.
